name: Build APK - ONLINE HYBRID

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Create ONLINE HYBRID project
        run: |
          rm -rf app
          mkdir -p app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone app/src/main/res/values app/src/main/assets

          cat > settings.gradle <<'EOF'
          pluginManagement {
              repositories { google(); mavenCentral(); gradlePluginPortal() }
          }
          dependencyResolutionManagement {
              repositoriesMode.set(RepositoriesMode.FAIL_ON_PROJECT_REPOS) {
                  repositories { google(); mavenCentral() }
              }
          }
          include ':app'
          EOF

          cat > build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins { id 'com.android.application' version '8.2.2' apply false }
          EOF

          cat > gradle.properties <<'EOF'
          org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2048m
          android.useAndroidX=true
          EOF

          cat > app/build.gradle <<'EOF'
          plugins { id 'com.android.application' }
          android {
              namespace 'com.hkbus.allinone'
              compileSdk 34
              defaultConfig {
                  applicationId "com.hkbus.allinone"
                  minSdk 24
                  targetSdk 34
                  versionCode 19
                  versionName "4.1-online-hybrid"
              }
          }
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/res/values/strings.xml <<'EOF'
          <resources><string name="app_name">全港交通</string></resources>
          EOF

          cat > app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml <<'EOF'
          <manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android">
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.INTERNET"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION"/>
            <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION"/>
            <application android:label="@string/app_name" android:theme="@android:style/Theme.NoTitleBar" android:hardwareAccelerated="true" android:usesCleartextTraffic="true">
              <activity android:name=".MainActivity" android:exported="true">
                <intent-filter><action android:name="android.intent.action.MAIN"/><category android:name="android.intent.category.LAUNCHER"/></intent-filter>
              </activity>
            </application>
          </manifest>
          EOF

          # 離線保底 HTML (如果線上都死，就顯示呢個 + 自動跳轉提示)
          cat > app/src/main/assets/index.html <<'HTML'
          <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>全港交通 - 離線保底</title>
          <style>body{font-family:sans-serif;background:#f5f5f7;padding:40px 20px;text-align:center}h2{margin-bottom:12px}.btn{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;padding:12px 20px;background:#1d1d1f;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none}</style></head>
          <body><h2>📡 連線中...</h2><p>正在嘗試連接 hketaapp.vercel.app</p><p style="color:#888;font-size:14px;margin-top:12px">如果一直卡住，會自動切換到離線版</p><script>setTimeout(function(){location.href="https://benyeung08.github.io/hketaapp/";},3000);</script></body></html>
          HTML

          cat > app/src/main/java/com/hkbus/allinone/MainActivity.java <<'EOF'
          package com.hkbus.allinone;
          import android.app.Activity;
          import android.os.Bundle;
          import android.webkit.*;
          import android.widget.Toast;

          public class MainActivity extends Activity {
              WebView wv;
              boolean fallbackDone = false;
              final String PRIMARY_URL = "https://hketaapp.vercel.app";
              final String SECONDARY_URL = "https://benyeung08.github.io/hketaapp/";
              final String OFFLINE_URL = "file:///android_asset/index.html";

              @Override
              protected void onCreate(Bundle b) {
                  super.onCreate(b);
                  wv = new WebView(this);
                  WebSettings s = wv.getSettings();
                  s.setJavaScriptEnabled(true);
                  s.setDomStorageEnabled(true);
                  s.setGeolocationEnabled(true);
                  s.setAllowFileAccess(true);
                  s.setAllowContentAccess(true);
                  s.setMixedContentMode(WebSettings.MIXED_CONTENT_ALWAYS_ALLOW);
                  s.setCacheMode(WebSettings.LOAD_DEFAULT);

                  wv.setWebChromeClient(new WebChromeClient() {
                      @Override
                      public void onGeolocationPermissionsShowPrompt(String origin, GeolocationPermissions.Callback callback) {
                          callback.invoke(origin, true, false);
                      }
                  });

                  wv.setWebViewClient(new WebViewClient() {
                      @Override
                      public boolean shouldOverrideUrlLoading(WebView view, WebResourceRequest request) {
                          String url = request.getUrl().toString();
                          if (url.contains("maps.google.com") || url.contains("google.com/maps")) {
                              try {
                                  view.getContext().startActivity(new android.content.Intent(android.content.Intent.ACTION_VIEW, android.net.Uri.parse(url)));
                                  return true;
                              } catch (Exception e) {}
                          }
                          return false;
                      }

                      @Override
                      public void onReceivedError(WebView view, WebResourceRequest request, WebResourceError error) {
                          if (request.isForMainFrame() && !fallbackDone) {
                              // 第一次失敗，試 GitHub Pages
                              if (view.getUrl() != null && view.getUrl().contains("vercel.app")) {
                                  view.loadUrl(SECONDARY_URL);
                              } else {
                                  fallbackDone = true;
                                  Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "線上版連線失敗，已切換離線版", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                                  view.loadUrl(OFFLINE_URL);
                              }
                          }
                      }

                      @Override
                      public void onReceivedHttpError(WebView view, WebResourceRequest request, WebResourceResponse errorResponse) {
                          // 處理 404 DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND
                          if (request.isForMainFrame() && errorResponse.getStatusCode() == 404 && !fallbackDone) {
                              if (view.getUrl() != null && view.getUrl().contains("vercel.app")) {
                                  view.loadUrl(SECONDARY_URL);
                              } else if (view.getUrl() != null && view.getUrl().contains("github.io")) {
                                  fallbackDone = true;
                                  Toast.makeText(MainActivity.this, "Vercel+GitHub 都 404，已切換離線版", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                                  view.loadUrl(OFFLINE_URL);
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  });

                  // 線上優先：先試 Vercel
                  wv.loadUrl(PRIMARY_URL);
                  setContentView(wv);
              }

              @Override
              public void onBackPressed() {
                  if (wv.canGoBack()) wv.goBack();
                  else super.onBackPressed();
              }
          }
          EOF

      - uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with: { distribution: 'temurin', java-version: '17' }
      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
        with: { gradle-version: '8.5', cache-disabled: true }
      - name: Install SDK
        run: |
          yes | $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --licenses || true
          $ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"
      - name: Build APK
        run: gradle :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon --stacktrace
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: hketaapp-online-hybrid
          path: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/*.apk
